question: YZWT is related to DEAX in a certain way based on the English alphabetical order. In the same way, QROL is related to VWSP. To which of the following is RSPM related, following the same logic?
solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/4a5b7cf84abd4e09a63d504f404b2035f579e6a3a005e11d54e3ca50bd42a099.png] 

Logic: (5) and (4) are added to the first two and last two letter position values according to the English alphabetic series respectively.

​​So,

YZWT is related to DEAX

​ [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/23aa104d3b5ec964237620deb55bd0a0798f6e06f203a5a408b3a422af1e2e48.png] 

​And,

QROL is related to VWSP

​ [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/8f82f72c178e59bd495486f73f2a7734fbce06cd23fd8c3c2e1633c5e4b034e7.png] 

​Similarly,

RSPM is related to

​ [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/8ee968b445fe75d4505b1a293d9327fc7952100428d39866a465726558da1211.png] 

Hence, "Option - (4)" is the correct answer.
